weapons.name: Iron Sword
weapons.description: Plain, honest and heavier than it looks. Every levy gets one.

weapons.name: Steel Sword
weapons.description: Better steel and a worse balance. Hits harder; asks more of the arm.

weapons.name: Ridgeblade
weapons.description: A narrow blade ground for riders. It finds the gap a saddle leaves.

weapons.name: Iron Lance
weapons.description: Ash shaft, iron head. Keeps the other end of a fight further away.

weapons.name: Steel Lance
weapons.description: Heavier than the iron one and sure of itself. Wants a strong hand.

weapons.name: Toll Spear
weapons.description: A gatekeeper's spear, long enough to reach past the first man.

weapons.name: Longpike
weapons.description: Made to punch through plate. Too long for anything else, really.

weapons.name: Hatchet
weapons.description: A woodcutter's tool before it was a weapon. Light, quick, forgiving.

weapons.name: Iron Axe
weapons.description: Heavy at the head and short on patience. Misses often; rarely twice.

weapons.name: Steel Axe
weapons.description: Splits shields and the arms behind them. Slow to come round again.

weapons.name: Toll Axe
weapons.description: Bearded axe with a long haft. Reaches two paces for whoever can lift it.

weapons.name: Post Maul
weapons.description: A fence-driver's maul. The swing takes a while; the landing does not.

weapons.name: Kinsbane
weapons.description: Placeholder. Drains 5 HP a phase it goes unfed; a kill heals 10.

weapons.name: Family Lance
weapons.description: Older than the house that kept it. Heavier than it should be.

stages.description: Placeholder. The rust comes off in flakes. What is under it is not iron.
Placeholder. Balanced now, or he has learned it. He will not say which.
Placeholder. It sits in his hands as if it had waited for them.

weapons.name: Iron Bow
weapons.description: Yew and gut, nothing fancy. Brings down birds and the people on them.

weapons.name: Steel Bow
weapons.description: Steel-backed and stiff to draw. Rewards the archer who keeps at it.

weapons.name: Cinder
weapons.description: A spark coaxed out of the air. Catches dry wood if you are careless.

weapons.name: Gust
weapons.description: Air shoved hard in one direction. Riders on wings hate it most.

weapons.name: Bolt
weapons.description: Lightning on a short leash. Bites hard and burns through its uses.

weapons.name: Iron Gauntlets
weapons.description: Iron over the knuckles. Not much reach, but they never get dropped.

weapons.name: Steel Gauntlets
weapons.description: Heavier plates over the fist. Each blow lands like a closed door.

weapons.name: Salve
weapons.description: A prayer for a cut that will not close. Mends whoever stands beside you.

weapons.name: Beacon
weapons.description: The same prayer, said louder. Reaches a friend two tiles off.

weapons.name: Radiance
weapons.description: Faith turned outward. Light that stings anyone the healer must face.
